description: `ServiceAccountPassword.serviceAccountPasswordId` is an identifier ("Service account password ID (read only)"), the `{serviceAccountPasswordId}` path label of `deleteServiceAccountPassword`, not a secret. The converter marks it sensitive only because its name contains `password`, which would hand callers a `Redacted` id to unwrap before deleting the password it names. The `password` member stays sensitive. Evidence: the field documentation and path in https://galaxy.starburst.io/public/openapi/v1/json (2026-11-11); no live call.
